description: Congresswoman Sylvia Garcia serves as the Vice Ranking Member of the House Financial Services Committee. During her first year in Congress, she played a critical role in the impeachment investigation against Donald Trump. She is the first Hispanic and one of the first three women to ever serve as an impeachment manager in a presidential impeachment trial.
